title: 防洪牆基礎設計~Floodwall foundation design
focus: 從靜水力到接觸與變形的防洪牆基礎推導~Floodwall foundation reasoning from hydrostatic action to contact and movement
summary: 課程串聯靜水合力、揚壓、抗滑、偏心接觸、承載與沉陷，再檢查被動土阻、防滲、接頭及退水反向作用。每個模型明示假設與量綱，區分荷載計算、強度和使用性。比尤德利與波士頓提供工程背景，但本課不把假設尺寸、強度或安全比值當成實際設計或地方核准。~The course connects hydrostatic force, uplift, sliding, eccentric contact, bearing and settlement before examining passive resistance, cutoffs, joints and recession loads. Each model identifies assumptions and dimensions while distinguishing loading, strength and serviceability. Bewdley and Boston provide engineering context, but assumed dimensions, strengths and resistance ratios are not project designs or local approvals.

units.anchor: 靜水荷載與作用點~Hydrostatic load and lever arm
units.title: 靜水荷載與作用點機理與驗證~Hydrostatic load and lever arm mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 防洪牆承受的靜水壓隨水深增加，沿垂直面形成三角形分布，合力與水深平方成正比而底部力矩隨立方改變。荷載必須連到牆身、底版與地基的傳力路徑，不能只以牆頂高度選構件；波浪、漂流物與兩側水位差還需另外建立情境，避免把單側靜水圖當完整設計。本例每公尺牆長、單側淡水、背側乾燥，基底與水深起點相同。忽略動水、土壓和結構自重，結果只是一項外荷載。~Hydrostatic pressure increases with depth, giving a triangular distribution on a vertical face. Force varies with depth squared and base moment with depth cubed. The load must follow a path through stem, footing and soil, rather than sizing from wall height alone. Waves, debris and differing water levels require separate cases beyond one-sided still water. The example is per metre of wall with freshwater on one side and a dry rear face, measured from the same base. Dynamic water, earth pressure and self-weight are excluded.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=3 m，合力F=γwh²/2=44.145 kN/m，作用點高h/3=1 m，底矩M=44.145 kN·m/m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume water unit weight 9.81 kN/m³ and depth h=3 m. Force F=44.145 kN/m acts 1 m above the base, producing moment 44.145 kN·m/m.
units.verify: 將兩側水位與基底高程放入同一剖面，逐項積分壓力並檢查合力作用點。列出土壓、波浪及漂流物是否另計，沿牆身到底版追蹤剪力與彎矩，不能只驗算水平力。~Place both water levels and the base on one section, integrate pressure and check its resultant location. List separate earth, wave and debris contributions and trace shear and bending into the footing instead of checking horizontal force alone as the complete load path.
units.failure: 把平均壓力作用在半水深會算錯力矩，漏掉背側水位又會誤判方向；使用水深平方比例估力矩會低估水位升高後的彎曲需求及地基偏心。~Applying average pressure at half depth gives the wrong moment, while omitted rear water can reverse the assumed direction. Scaling moment with depth squared understates bending and foundation eccentricity as water rises above the original level.
units.misconception: 水深增加一成時，防洪牆的底部水壓力矩也只增加一成。~A ten-percent increase in depth increases hydrostatic base moment by only ten percent.
units.practice: 畫出不同水深的三角壓力分布並積分合力與力矩，分開列平方和立方比例。再加入背側水位，說明何時應扣除另一個三角形而不是只用水深差平方。~Draw triangular pressure diagrams for two depths and integrate force and moment, listing square and cube scaling separately. Add rear water and explain why subtracting two triangles differs from squaring only the depth difference.

units.anchor: 底版揚壓與合力位置~Footing uplift and resultant location
units.title: 底版揚壓與合力位置機理與驗證~Footing uplift and resultant location mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 底版下的孔壓可減少有效向下作用並產生額外力矩，其分布取決於排水、地層及防滲構造，不一定只由兩端水位決定。線性揚壓圖可作教學積分，但排水孔堵塞或局部缺陷可能改變形狀，因此基礎穩定需要同時保留揚壓合力和位置，不能只從自重減一個沒有作用點的總數。本例為每公尺牆長的水平底版，假設揚壓沿寬度線性由高端降到低端；不是由兩個端點自動證明的現場壓力分布。~Pore pressure beneath a footing reduces effective downward load and contributes moment. Its distribution depends on drainage, strata and cutoffs rather than endpoint stages alone. A linear diagram is useful for integration, but blocked drains and defects can alter its shape. Stability therefore needs both uplift magnitude and location, not merely a scalar deduction from weight. This is a horizontal footing per metre of wall with assumed linear uplift from high to low edge. Two endpoint observations do not automatically prove that distribution in the field.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設底寬B=4 m，高低端揚壓p1=30、p2=10 kPa，U=(p1+p2)B/2=80 kN/m，合力距高壓端1.667 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume width B=4 m and edge uplifts p1=30, p2=10 kPa. U=(p1+p2)B/2=80 kN/m; its resultant is 1.667 m from the high-pressure edge.
units.verify: 把揚壓圖拆成矩形與三角形分別求合力和力矩，核對端點方向與座標。用底版下多點孔壓檢查形狀，另外分析排水失效及洪水快速變化，避免只用正常排水圖。~Split the uplift diagram into rectangular and triangular parts, checking force, moment and coordinate orientation. Compare its shape with several under-footing pressures and analyze drainage failure and rapid stage changes separately instead of carrying only the normal-drainage assumption into stability calculations.
units.failure: 錯置合力位置會讓抗傾覆帳失真，直接以背水側低壓套全底版則可能低估揚壓；若排水管堵塞仍沿用原圖，滑動及接觸壓力的有效載重都會過於樂觀。~A misplaced uplift resultant distorts overturning balance. Applying only the low rear pressure across the base understates uplift, and retaining a drained diagram after blockage overstates the effective loads available for sliding resistance and bearing contact.
units.misconception: 只要揚壓總力算對，它作用在底版何處就完全不影響穩定。~Correct total uplift makes its position beneath the footing irrelevant to stability.
units.practice: 用相同揚壓總力配置兩個不同壓力圖，計算各自對底邊力矩。列出新增中間孔壓測點能排除的假設，說明為何只量兩端仍有未解不確定性。~Construct two uplift diagrams with equal force and calculate their moments about one edge. List assumptions that an intermediate pressure measurement can test and explain uncertainty remaining when only endpoint pressures are known.

units.anchor: 有效法向力與滑動~Effective normal load and sliding
units.title: 有效法向力與滑動機理與驗證~Effective normal load and sliding mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 底版摩擦取決於接觸面的有效法向作用，揚壓會減少可用摩擦力，不能一面以浮重計自重又重複扣除全部揚壓。界面強度、黏著與前方被動土阻力需有相應證據及可動員變形；受沖刷或未來開挖影響的土體也不能無條件當永久抗力。本例自重採未扣揚壓的總向下力，只考慮無黏著庫侖摩擦，未計土被動阻力或錨定；所得為指定機理的比值，非規範驗收。~Base friction depends on effective normal action, which uplift reduces. Weight and buoyancy conventions must avoid deducting the same water effect twice. Interface strength, adhesion and passive soil resistance require evidence and compatible mobilization movements. Soil exposed to scour or future excavation cannot automatically be credited as permanent resistance in a sliding assessment. The example starts with gross downward weight and includes cohesionless Coulomb interface friction only, excluding passive resistance and anchorage. The resulting mechanism ratio is not a code acceptance decision.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總向下力W=200 kN/m、揚壓U=80 kN/m、μ=0.50、水平H=40 kN/m，R=μ(W−U)=60 kN/m，R/H=1.50。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross W=200 kN/m, uplift U=80 kN/m, friction μ=0.50 and horizontal H=40 kN/m. Resistance R=60 kN/m and ratio R/H=1.50.
units.verify: 核對重量與揚壓是否採相容定義，檢查界面試驗、粗糙度與施工接觸條件。列明未採用的黏著和被動抗力，另考慮沖刷、排水失效及反向荷載，不把計算比值直接標示合格。~Check consistent weight/uplift definitions and evidence for interface behavior, roughness and construction contact. Identify excluded adhesion and passive resistance, and assess scour, failed drainage and reversed loading separately rather than treating a computed resistance ratio as an automatic compliance result.
units.failure: 用總自重計摩擦而忽略揚壓會高估抗力，將浮重再減全揚壓則可能重複扣水效應；把會被沖走的土算成永久被動抗力，也會隱藏失去支承後的滑動風險。~Using gross weight for friction ignores uplift, while subtracting full uplift from an already buoyant weight can double-count water. Crediting scour-prone soil as permanent passive resistance hides the change in sliding response after support is lost.
units.misconception: 底版摩擦永遠由全部自重決定，地下水揚壓不會改變抗滑力。~Base friction always uses full self-weight and is unaffected by groundwater uplift.
units.practice: 用同一牆重比較兩種揚壓的抗滑比，清楚列出未採用的抗力。再移除前方可能沖刷的土體，說明為何抗力必須符合相同荷載情境與變形條件。~Compare sliding ratios at two uplifts for the same wall weight, identifying excluded resistances. Remove potentially scoured front soil and explain why resistance must correspond to the same load case and compatible movement conditions.

units.anchor: 偏心與底面接觸~Eccentricity and footing contact
units.title: 偏心與底面接觸機理與驗證~Eccentricity and footing contact mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 合力偏離底版中心會使接觸壓力一側升高另一側降低，在剛性底版與線彈性全接觸近似下可由軸力和力矩估算邊緣壓力。當計算出拉應力時，土通常不能提供所假設的拉力，須改用部分接觸模型；全接觸公式的負值不是可忽略的小數，而是模型邊界已改變的訊號。本例所有載重已含水力效應，N為有效淨向下力、M為對中心的淨力矩，每公尺牆長計。只檢查全接觸線性壓力，不評定承載強度。~An eccentric resultant raises contact stress at one edge and lowers it at the other. A rigid footing with linear full contact permits edge stresses from axial force and moment. Calculated tension usually cannot be sustained by soil, requiring a partial-contact model. A negative full-contact stress signals a changed boundary rather than a harmless numerical artifact. All hydraulic effects are included: N is net effective downward action and M its net moment about the center, per metre of wall. This checks linear full contact only, not bearing strength.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設B=4 m、N=120 kN/m、M=60 kN·m/m，e=M/N=0.50 m；qmax,min=N/B(1±6e/B)=52.5、7.5 kPa。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume B=4 m, N=120 kN/m and M=60 kN·m/m. Eccentricity e=0.50 m; full-contact edge pressures are qmax=52.5 and qmin=7.5 kPa.
units.verify: 以一致中心座標加總所有力矩，核對偏心距與B/6的全壓接觸界限。檢查底版剛度、地層均勻性和壓力分布假設，再另做承載、沉陷及結構驗算，避免把正壓力當全面安全。~Sum moments about a consistent center and compare eccentricity with the B/6 full-compression limit. Check footing rigidity, soil uniformity and the assumed pressure distribution, then assess bearing, settlement and structural response separately instead of interpreting positive contact stress as comprehensive safety.
units.failure: 把外水水平力矩與揚壓力矩漏算或重算會改變偏心，使用部分接觸時仍保留全寬線性壓力則可能低估峰值；正的最小壓力也不能證明地基承載或沉陷足夠。~Omitted or duplicated water moments alter eccentricity. Retaining a full-width pressure model after contact is lost can understate peak stress, while a positive minimum stress says nothing by itself about bearing capacity or acceptable settlement.
units.misconception: 底面最小壓力大於零，就足以證明承載、沉陷與牆身強度全都合格。~Positive minimum footing pressure proves bearing, settlement and wall strength all acceptable.
units.practice: 逐步增加中心力矩，找出最小接觸壓力變成零的點並停止全接觸外推。列出此後需要的接觸幾何與地基資訊，區分壓力分布和承載強度問題。~Increase center moment until minimum contact stress reaches zero and stop full-contact extrapolation. List the contact geometry and soil information needed afterward, distinguishing stress-distribution questions from soil bearing-strength questions.

units.anchor: 黏土承載模式篩選~Undrained clay bearing screening
units.title: 黏土承載模式篩選機理與驗證~Undrained clay bearing screening mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 地基承載破壞與正常使用沉陷不同，短期飽和黏土可在特定幾何下以不排水強度建立承載尺度。承載係數會隨形狀、埋深、荷載傾斜、地面坡度與土層變化，不能將無埋深條形基礎的簡式套所有防洪牆；偏心和揚壓還必須先以相容方式納入作用。本例水平地面、地表無限長條形基礎、均質不排水黏土及垂直置中荷載，取理想Nc=5.14；是淨極限承載力，不是容許壓力。~Bearing failure differs from service settlement. Short-term saturated clay can provide an undrained bearing scale under specific geometry. Coefficients vary with shape, embedment, load inclination, ground slope and layering, so a surface strip-footing expression is not universal for floodwalls. Eccentricity and uplift also require compatible treatment in the applied actions. The example assumes level ground, a surface strip footing, uniform undrained clay and centered vertical loading with ideal Nc=5.14. It gives net ultimate bearing capacity, not allowable pressure.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設不排水強度su=40 kPa、Nc=5.14，淨極限承載力qnet,ult=Ncsu=205.6 kPa；未施安全係數或折減。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume undrained strength su=40 kPa and Nc=5.14. Ideal net ultimate bearing qnet,ult=Ncsu=205.6 kPa, before any safety factor or reduction.
units.verify: 檢查強度測試的應力路徑、取樣擾動及地層代表性，辨識短期與長期排水狀態。若偏心、傾斜或分層不符簡式，改用相應模型；再獨立驗算沉陷，不能把極限承載值當使用壓力。~Check the strength-test stress path, sample disturbance and representativeness and distinguish short-term from long-term drainage. Replace the simple expression where eccentricity, inclination or layering violate assumptions, and independently assess settlement rather than using ultimate capacity as a service-pressure recommendation.
units.failure: 把淨極限承載力直接與未整理的總壓力相比會混淆定義，軟弱下臥層也可能控制破壞；即使承載強度有餘量，長期壓密仍可能使接縫和止水失效。~Comparing net ultimate capacity with an inconsistent gross stress confuses definitions, and a weak underlying layer may control failure. Even with bearing-strength reserve, long-term consolidation can impair wall joints and waterstops through differential movement.
units.misconception: 極限承載力就是工程可長期使用的容許壓力，不需檢查沉陷。~Ultimate bearing capacity is the permissible long-term service pressure without settlement checks.
units.practice: 建立淨壓力與總壓力的對照，再列出條形基礎簡式缺少的幾何修正。提出能辨識軟弱下層的調查配置，並說明強度資料為何不能獨自決定使用性。~Compare net and gross pressure definitions and list geometric corrections missing from the strip-footing expression. Propose investigation capable of finding a weak lower layer and explain why strength data cannot alone establish serviceability.

units.anchor: 基礎彈性變形尺度~Elastic foundation deformation scale
units.title: 基礎彈性變形尺度機理與驗證~Elastic foundation deformation scale mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 牆基即使未達承載破壞也會變形，沉陷差可能使板段接頭張開或頂高失去餘量。彈性半空間公式可展示壓力、寬度與剛度的比例關係，但土模數與應力水準、排水時間及應變大小有關；形狀係數亦取決於基礎與取點，因此估算尺度不能冒充完整分層沉陷分析。本例明定理想彈性均質半空間及指定影響係數，不含一次壓密與次壓縮。模數以千帕一致代入，結果僅是此理想模型的位移尺度。~A foundation deforms before bearing failure, and differential settlement can open joints or reduce crest margin. Elastic half-space relations show scaling with pressure, width and stiffness, but soil modulus depends on stress level, drainage time and strain. Shape factors also depend on footing geometry and evaluation point, so a scale estimate cannot substitute for layered settlement analysis. The example specifies a uniform elastic half-space and assigned influence factor, excluding primary and secondary consolidation. Modulus is converted consistently to kilopascals; displacement belongs only to this idealized model.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設q=50 kPa、B=4 m、ν=0.30、E=20,000 kPa、影響係數I=1.0，s=qB(1−ν²)I/E=0.00910 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume q=50 kPa, B=4 m, Poisson ratio ν=0.30, E=20,000 kPa and influence I=1.0. Elastic displacement scale s=0.00910 m.
units.verify: 確認所用模數和影響係數對應相同排水、應變及基礎條件，另查軟弱層厚度與時間效應。以分段高程觀測比較相對沉陷，核對是否有剛體傾斜，再評估接頭可容許變位。~Confirm modulus and influence factor match drainage, strain and footing conditions, then investigate weak-layer thickness and time effects separately. Compare relative settlements from segment elevations, distinguish rigid-body tilt and assess joint movement capacity rather than relying only on one predicted absolute displacement.
units.failure: 把兆帕未換單位就與千帕荷載相除會產生千倍誤差，任選形狀係數也會使精度虛假；以瞬時彈性結果代表多年沉陷，則漏掉可能控制止水接頭的壓密差。~Dividing kilopascal loading by an unconverted megapascal modulus creates a thousand-fold error. An arbitrary shape factor implies false precision, and treating instantaneous elasticity as years of settlement omits consolidation differences that can control waterstop performance.
units.misconception: 計算得到小的瞬時彈性沉陷，就能排除所有長期接頭變形。~Small calculated instantaneous elastic settlement excludes every long-term joint movement problem.
units.practice: 將模數減半而保持其餘條件不變，重算理想位移並列出未包含的時間效應。用相鄰牆段高程分開計算平均下沉和差異位移，避免混淆兩種使用性問題。~Halve modulus with other assumptions fixed and recalculate elastic displacement, listing omitted time effects. Use adjacent segment elevations to separate average settlement from relative movement rather than confusing the two serviceability concerns.

units.anchor: 被動土壓與可動員變形~Passive pressure and mobilization
units.title: 被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證~Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 基礎前方土體可提供被動阻力，但充分動員通常需要位移，並受土面坡度、牆土摩擦和應力歷史影響。理想朗肯係數只適用特定無摩擦垂直面與水平地面，並非所有鋼板樁或剪力榫的抗力；前方沖刷與開挖還可能移除可用土體，需和牆的容許變形共同判斷。本例只算無黏乾砂、水平面、光滑直牆的理想係數，未算總抗力，也未宣稱已達被動狀態；飽和土需一致有效應力處理。~Soil ahead of a foundation can provide passive resistance, but full mobilization requires movement and depends on ground slope, interface friction and stress history. The ideal Rankine coefficient applies to a smooth vertical interface and level ground, not every sheet pile or shear key. Scour and excavation can remove the resisting soil, linking resistance to allowable wall movement. The example computes only an ideal coefficient for cohesionless dry sand, level ground and a smooth vertical wall. It neither gives total resistance nor establishes mobilization; saturated soil needs consistent effective-stress treatment.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效摩擦角φ′=30°，理想朗肯被動係數Kp=tan²(45°+φ′/2)=3.00，無單位。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective friction angle φ′=30°. Ideal Rankine passive coefficient Kp=tan²(45°+φ′/2)=3.00, dimensionless, without a total-resistance claim.
units.verify: 核對土面幾何、界面與地下水，列出需要動員被動阻力的方向及位移。檢查前方土是否可能沖走、開挖或受管線擾動，再使用適合邊界的模型並與結構可接受變形比較。~Check ground geometry, interface and groundwater, identifying the movement needed to mobilize passive resistance. Assess whether front soil can be scoured, excavated or disturbed by utilities, then choose a boundary-compatible model and compare its required deformation with structural serviceability limits.
units.failure: 只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。~Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements. Omitting future excavation or scour allows a sliding calculation to depend on material that may no longer be present.
units.misconception: 朗肯被動係數算出後，任何微小位移都能立即動員全部被動抗力。~Once the Rankine coefficient is calculated, any tiny displacement immediately mobilizes full passive resistance.
units.practice: 分別畫出未變形、局部動員與被動極限三種狀態，列出同一係數不能回答的問題。移除一層前方土後重新界定埋深，說明調查與維護介面的重要性。~Draw undeformed, partially mobilized and limiting passive states and list questions that one coefficient cannot answer. Remove a front-soil layer, redefine embedment and explain the investigation and maintenance implications of that changed geometry.

units.anchor: 截水深度與滲透方向~Cutoff depth and seepage direction
units.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證~Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 牆基防滲構造不只減漏，也會改變底版揚壓和出口位置，深度增加可能使流路轉移至較深透水層。以均質流徑延長估算只表示水力阻抗尺度，實際需考慮二維或三維流線、層間異向性及牆尖梯度；總漏水下降不一定表示所有局部孔壓同步下降。本例使用指定長度的固定截面飽和一維路徑，水頭差與滲透係數不變。延長流路不是把實際牆深直接代入，也不提供出口侵蝕判定。~Foundation cutoffs reduce leakage but also redistribute uplift and exit locations; greater depth can redirect flow into deeper permeable strata. A lengthened uniform path gives only a resistance scale. Actual analysis needs two- or three-dimensional flow, anisotropic layers and tip gradients, because lower total discharge does not necessarily lower every local pore pressure. This example uses an assigned saturated one-dimensional path of constant area, head difference and conductivity. Path extension is not actual wall depth substituted directly, and it gives no exit-erosion acceptance.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=10 m²、Δh=4 m、L=20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s；路徑40 m時為2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s, A=10 m², Δh=4 m and L=20 m. Q=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s; increasing the ideal path to 40 m halves it.
units.verify: 在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。比較有無防滲構造時的揚壓分布及局部出口梯度，用實測孔壓和流量共同驗證而非只看漏水總數。~Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers. Compare uplift distributions and local exit gradients with and without the cutoff, validating against both measured pressure and discharge rather than total leakage alone as the performance metric.
units.failure: 把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。~Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass. Claiming improved stability solely from reduced leakage can miss adverse gradients concentrated near a cutoff tip or exit.
units.misconception: 防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。~A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location.
units.practice: 對一維模型改變流長，另外畫一條繞牆尖的替代路徑。列出需要二維分析才能比較的孔壓位置，說明流量減半不等於每一處梯度減半。~Change path length in the one-dimensional model and draw a separate route around the cutoff tip. Identify pressure locations needing two-dimensional analysis and explain why halved discharge does not imply halved gradient everywhere.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷與止水接頭~Differential movement and waterstops
units.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證~Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 相鄰牆段的位移差會改變止水材料與接頭幾何，整段平均沉陷很小仍可能在轉折或地層變化處集中變形。以兩測點高差除距離只能得到平均沉陷斜率，未扣剛體轉動時不能直接叫構件角變形；接頭還可能受到開口、剪移和轉角的組合作用，需要與可驗證的材料容許值比較。本例僅為兩點高差的幾何平均斜率，未分解牆段剛體傾斜或局部曲率；不能單憑這個比值計算止水接觸壓力或證明水密。~Relative movement between wall segments changes waterstop and joint geometry, and a small average settlement can conceal concentration at bends or layer transitions. Elevation difference divided by spacing gives a mean settlement slope, not automatically component angular distortion before removing rigid-body rotation. Joints also experience combined opening, shear and rotation that require validated material capacities. This is only the geometric mean slope between two points, without separation of rigid-body tilt or local curvature. It cannot calculate waterstop contact pressure or establish watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m. Mean settlement slope Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m, without a waterstop-capacity claim.
units.verify: 統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。量測接頭開口和剪移，取得止水材料在相應溫度、老化與壓差下的性能資料，並以適當漏水測試核對。~Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature. Measure opening and shear and obtain waterstop performance at relevant temperature, aging and pressure difference, checking with appropriate leakage tests rather than inferring sealing behavior from two elevations.
units.failure: 將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。~Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure. No visible crack does not confirm the integrity of hidden waterstops, connections or their response under pressure.
units.misconception: 兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。~Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness.
units.practice: 用三個以上測點分解一個假設的剛體傾斜與局部相對變形，另列開口與剪移。說明仍須哪些材料曲線與漏水試驗，才能連結幾何量測和止水性能。~Use at least three points to separate a hypothetical rigid tilt from local relative movement, listing opening and shear independently. Explain which material curves and leakage tests are still required to connect geometry with sealing performance.

units.anchor: 退水與反向荷載情境~Recession and reversed loading
units.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證~Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 洪水退去後，背側積水或地基孔壓可能尚未消散，原本抵抗外河水的牆會遇到不同方向或分布的作用。水位變化、抽排和排水堵塞應以時間一致的荷載組合處理，不能把各自最大值任意拼湊也不能只檢查最高河水位；反向荷載還可能動員不同界面及接觸區域。本例兩側直牆水深由同一底面量起，取外河向背側為正，僅相減兩個靜水合力；未包含基底揚壓或土壓。~After river recession, retained water or foundation pressure may persist, changing the direction and distribution of wall loads. Stage change, pumping and blocked drainage need time-consistent combinations, neither arbitrary combinations of unrelated maxima nor only peak river stage. Reversed loading may also mobilize different interfaces, contacts and structural reinforcement than the original forward case. Depths on both vertical faces share the same base, with river-to-landward force positive. The example subtracts two hydrostatic resultants only, excluding base uplift and earth pressure.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m. Net F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m, directed riverward.
units.verify: 將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。明列正負方向和不同作用點，追蹤反向彎矩與接觸區變化，再檢查止水和排水是否可在兩向壓差下運作。~Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure. State signs and lever arms, trace reversed moments and changing contact regions and check whether seals and drainage can function under pressure differences in both directions.
units.failure: 只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。~Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession. Squaring the depth difference loses the shared-base geometry, and ignoring slower pore-pressure dissipation produces an inconsistent time history of effective foundation loading and resistance.
units.misconception: 外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。~Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together.
units.practice: 建立河水先降而背水暫留的三個時點，逐一計算淨力方向。另畫可能延遲的底版孔壓，說明需要時間相容荷載而不能只挑最高河水位。~Create three times with falling river water and temporarily retained rear water, calculating force direction at each. Sketch delayed footing pressures and explain why time-consistent loads are needed instead of choosing only the maximum river stage.

example: 敏感度固定單側靜水、每公尺牆長和水單位重9.81 kN/m³，只把水深從3.0增至3.3 m。合力由44.145增至53.41545 kN/m，增加21%；底部力矩由44.145增至58.7570 kN·m/m，增加33.1%。兩者分別按水深平方和立方變化，不能使用相同百分比。這並不直接給出基礎偏心的新值，因為底版揚壓、垂直水重及其他荷載可能也變動；完整比較必須重新組合相同時刻的各項作用，確認接觸模型仍適用，並獨立檢查承載、滑動與變形。~Hold one-sided still water, unit wall length and water unit weight at 9.81 kN/m³ while raising depth from 3.0 to 3.3 m. Force rises from 44.145 to 53.41545 kN/m, an increase of 21%; base moment rises from 44.145 to 58.7570 kN·m/m, an increase of 33.1%. Force and moment scale with depth squared and cubed respectively. This does not directly give a new foundation eccentricity, because uplift, vertical water weight and other loads may also change. A complete comparison recombines all actions at compatible times, confirms the contact model remains applicable and independently checks bearing, sliding and deformation. No acceptance criterion is inferred from the scaling exercise alone.
history: 環境署資料記錄比尤德利塞文河北區於2004年、南區於2006年完成，結合混凝土牆、可拆擋板及抽水站；2020年維護公告特別涉及地面滲漏和接縫重封。波士頓主要防洪閘及相連工程於2020年十二月完成，但不等於所有後續港口工程都在該年竣工。工兵團官方目錄核對2022年防洪牆手冊的版本與範圍，本課未把取得受限的全文條文當已逐條核實。數值均為獨立假設，用來說明力學與資料需求。~Environment Agency records identify Severnside North completion in 2004 and South in 2006, combining concrete walls, removable barriers and pumps. Its 2020 maintenance release specifically addresses ground seepage and resealing. Boston’s primary gate and associated works completed in December 2020, not every later port-related component. The Corps official catalogue verifies the 2022 floodwall manual edition and scope; restricted full text is not represented as clause-by-clause verification. Numerical examples are independent assumptions explaining mechanics and evidence needs.

U=(p1+p2)B/2=80 kN/m; its resultant is 1.667 m from the high-pressure edge.

Resistance R=60 kN/m and ratio R/H=1.50.

Eccentricity e=0.50 m; full-contact edge pressures are qmax=52.5 and qmin=7.5 kPa.
